quote: A workout in a FIT format is a file including all the relevant information from your workout: location, time, timestamps, heart rate, power, cadence, etc.
They are the preferred format for workout export and use in different services.
A workout in a GPX format is a file including both location and time information from your workout (and, where available, heart rate data).
don't contain all the information available in the Suunto app.
A route in a GPX format is a file including only the location information from your workout.

claim: Export path: three dots, top right.
quote: and in the top right corner, tap the three dots.
exercise recordings without GPS will not have the possibility of exporting GPX files, only FIT files.
